searchText: <@425274498732916736> the poll doesn't say what level the workshop would be aimed for. Are*coredevs* execution client devs that are already familiar with every single opcode in the EVM or can consensus client devs that are curious but don't know the basics of reentrancy learn something in the planned workshop? If it's the latter, with a couple of highly intensive minicourses, I'd be very much interested regardless of the place (although Bogotá would be perfect given that I plan to go anyway) The main group should be execution client devs, but we can have intro talks too. This should be good for onboarding. The very little I've read falls into completely trivial stuff that takes forever do get anywhere, or texts that assumed that the reader knew the subtleties and the possible attacks on CREATE2, KILL and so forth, so couldn't find anything intermediate that wouldn't treat me as complete stupid or expert. I guess eventually I could gather time and courage and read the specification, but I think a learning workshop would be much better
